name: Scepter
overview: The scepter in Scripture is primarily a symbol of divine authority and kingship, as seen in Genesis 49:10 where it represents the enduring rule of Judah until the coming of Shiloh. It is also depicted as a tangible sign of favor or disfavor from the king, notably in Esther 4:11 and 5:2, where the golden scepter grants life and favor to those who approach the king. Figuratively, the scepter can be made of gold, symbolizing royal dignity, or iron, representing strength and judgment, as Psalm 2:9 describes breaking enemies with a rod of iron. Together, these passages reveal the scepter's role as a powerful emblem of both sovereign authority and divine judgment.
